column1: Analyst: Avery Patel. As-of date: 11/03/2026. All organizations and people are fictional.
VAT and bank values are invented TEST tokens, not valid identifiers. Similar tokens are used only to teach matching.
For this exercise only, a record is dormant if its last payment was more than 24 months before the as-of date. A blank last-payment date is unknown, not evidence of dormancy.
